news.title: Ripple Leaves October’s 1 Billion XRP Unlock Untouched for 26 Days: Will Swell Week Change That?
news.body: Ripple opened Swell 2026 in New York on Tuesday, October 27, a day after winning final OCC approval for its national trust bank, while the 1 billion XRP it unlocked from escrow on October 1 has still not left its wallets. That last part is the XRP Ripple story most of this week’s coverage misses... news.reason: Факт о задержке вывода XRP из эскроу + событие Swell, но неясен механизм влияния на цену

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs Own Just 8.5% of BTC as IBIT Ends a Two-Day Outflow Run: Can BTC USD Hold $79,200?
news.body: BTC USD traded near $79,700 on Tuesday, October 27, after U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $110.3 million on Monday, ending a two-day, $773.4 million outflow run a day before the Federal Reserve’s rate decision. All of it went into one fund: BlackRock’s IBIT. The flows look small next to the coins the funds track... The post Bitcoin ETFs Own Just 8.5% of BTC as IBIT Ends a Two-Day Outflow Run: Can BTC USD Hold $79,200? appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
news.reason: Позитивный факт притока в IBIT ($110.3M), но минимальный объём относительно всего BTC, слабое краткосрочное влияние

news.title: Ripple Secures Major US Banking Approval, XRP Fails to Rally
news.body: Ripple has secured final US regulatory approval for its national trust bank, marking a major milestone for the company.
